stories.title: Clashes in Barcelona as thousands join Spain general strike
stories.summary: Spain's first general strike in 14 years brought tens of thousands into the streets over housing costs and wages, with scuffles breaking out in Barcelona. It signals how far cost-of-living anger is now spilling into national politics across Europe.

stories.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
stories.summary: Two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi produced agreement on a large prisoner exchange but no deal on a ceasefire or territory, and US envoys meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday. The exchange is the first concrete result of direct Kyiv-Moscow talks in nine months.

stories.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
stories.summary: Bessent has moved onto a military base following alleged Iranian threats, making him one of several Trump administration officials living on bases for security reasons. It points to how Iran's retaliation campaign is now shaping daily security posture in Washington.

stories.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
stories.summary: Indonesia's vice president stepped down as President Prabowo's relationship with predecessor Joko Widodo deteriorates, unsettling the governing coalition. The exit raises questions about stability in Southeast Asia's largest economy.

stories.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments and shorter contracts to fund AI growth
stories.summary: In its third-quarter earnings, CoreWeave said it is asking customers to pay upfront and borrowing against specific contracts to finance its AI buildout. The shift suggests the AI infrastructure boom is increasingly dependent on strained financing arrangements.

stories.title: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
stories.summary: OpenAI's quarterly sales reportedly topped $10 billion, roughly a 50% jump from $6.7 billion the prior quarter. The pace shows enterprise and consumer AI spending is still accelerating despite cost concerns.

stories.title: Google's AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
stories.summary: DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, trained on more than 100 million cell profiles across 68 tissues, to predict how genetic variants affect specific cell types. It is available through the AlphaGenome API for non-commercial research, with a private preview for commercial use.

stories.title: Databricks' new Genie agent takes on multistep work unsupervised
stories.summary: Databricks updated Genie so it can run extended, multistep tasks using an ontology built over customer data, with CEO Ali Ghodsi using it internally to surface uncomfortable feedback. It is part of the push to sell always-on agents to business leaders rather than just developers.

stories.title: Browns' aggressive line movement blamed for run-defense woes
stories.summary: Cleveland's disruptive defensive line games are opening running lanes that opponents are attacking with trap and wham blocks, cleveland.com analysis found. Houston arrives Sunday with a run game that could exploit exactly that.

stories.title: Browns to start Deshaun Watson at quarterback vs. Texans
stories.summary: Cleveland is going back to Deshaun Watson against his former team on Sunday after he missed one game in the concussion protocol, with Shedeur Sanders returning to backup. The move ends a week of ambiguity from coach Todd Monken about the position.

stories.title: Watson back as Browns starter over Sanders for Week 10
stories.summary: One game lost to a concussion was not enough to cost Watson the job, with Cleveland naming him starter for the Nov. 15 home game against Houston. Sanders had rallied the Browns late in New Orleans but the staff still preferred Watson's experience.

stories.title: Ohio State launches 'JJ 4 It All' campaign for Jeremiah Smith
stories.summary: Ohio State is promoting Smith for the Heisman, Biletnikoff, Maxwell and Walter Camp awards while tying the push to beating Michigan. Smith leads the Big Ten in catches, yards and touchdowns and leads the nation in scoring catches.

stories.title: Ryan Day sticks with Luke Fahey at quarterback vs. Northwestern
stories.summary: Day confirmed true freshman Luke Fahey will make his third straight start Saturday despite back-to-back losses, saying Tavien St. Clair remains one snap away but has not earned the job yet. The offense has sputtered since Julian Sayin's injury.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith named Walter Camp Award semifinalist
stories.summary: Smith was named a semifinalist for the Walter Camp Player of the Year award for the second straight year, a day after landing on the Maxwell list. He has 69 catches for 1,200 yards and 14 touchdowns entering Week 11.

stories.title: Three takeaways from Ryan Day's Week 11 press conference
stories.summary: Land-Grant Holy Land's read on Day's presser: Fahey stays at quarterback, getting the ball to Jeremiah Smith is 'always a priority' after he went untargeted for 32 minutes at Oregon, and the pass rush ranks next-to-last among Power 4 teams. Northwestern visits Ohio Stadium Saturday at noon.

stories.title: Verstappen heads to Las Vegas on an eight-race podium streak
stories.summary: Verstappen has finished in the top three in eight straight races and holds a 17-point cushion over George Russell for second in the standings. He says Las Vegas is hard to predict because energy management on its long start-finish straight changes the usual pecking order.

stories.title: Stella wants McLaren to 'finally' make peace with Las Vegas
stories.summary: McLaren's team principal called Las Vegas probably the team's toughest race but says he heads there with optimism after Lando Norris's wet-weather win in Brazil. Las Vegas opens F1's closing triple header on Nov. 21.

stories.title: Drivers criticise 250kW wet-weather power cap after Interlagos
stories.summary: Arvid Lindblad and Gabriel Bortoleto said the FIA's safety cap on electrical deployment, which cuts output from 350kW to 250kW in the wet, left them hitting an energy ceiling exactly when trying to overtake. Both lost ground in traffic in Brazil as a result.

stories.title: What the Brazilian GP revealed about F1's ability to cope with rain
stories.summary: Autosport's review found the 2026 cars behaved better in the wet than feared and generated less spray, but Pirelli's intermediates remain slow to warm and wear quickly. Teams now worry a cold, wet Las Vegas weekend could expose the same tyre problem.

stories.title: Players report tarcoin spawns in Tarbank have been quietly cut
stories.summary: Tarkov players are reporting far fewer tarcoins and smaller stacks from Tarbank runs than earlier in the season, with no matching line in the official patch notes. If confirmed, it is another stealth loot-economy change affecting progression in the Kord Breach season.

stories.title: Fentanyl killed four of five people in Franklin County overdose surge
stories.summary: Final autopsy results show fentanyl caused four of the five deaths in a single 24-hour overdose spike in September, 10TV reported. The findings underscore how potent the local drug supply remains despite years of overdose-reduction efforts.

stories.title: Missing Licking County woman found dead in pond
stories.summary: A 77-year-old woman reported missing in Licking County early Wednesday was found dead in a pond hours later, according to the sheriff's office. Authorities have not released a cause of death.

stories.title: OhioHealth plans $700M, 160-bed hospital at former Big Lots HQ
stories.summary: OhioHealth will build New Albany Methodist Hospital near Hamilton Road and State Route 161 on the old Big Lots headquarters site, with construction expected to start in early 2027 and an opening around 2030. It adds another major medical campus to the fast-growing northeast Columbus corridor.

stories.title: Kentucky brunch chain picks northeast Columbus for first central Ohio site
stories.summary: The chain is preparing to open in a retail strip near Gahanna and New Albany, with a second central Ohio location planned near Dublin. It is the latest restaurant group betting on the northeast corridor's growth.
